container.title: Visual Agent
cmd.translateResult: Translate Review Result / 翻译审查结果…
config.followAgentByDefault: Initial state of the Follow Agent toggle when a workspace is opened for the first time.
config.stepDelayMs: Delay between mock agent operations, in milliseconds, so each step can be observed.
config.requireApprovalForCommands: Also require approval before (simulated) Execute/Test operations run. Edits always require approval.
config.allowNavigationOutsideWorkspace: Allow navigation to files outside the open workspace folder. Off by default for safety.
config.codex.executablePath: Path to the native Codex binary (codex / codex.exe). Empty = auto-detect the npm-installed @openai/codex. Shell scripts (.cmd/.ps1) are not accepted.
config.codex.model: Codex model id for Visual Agent sessions. Empty = the default model reported by the Codex app-server (model/list).
config.codex.defaultProfile: Safety profile preselected when starting a Codex task.
config.codex.defaultProfile.0: Read-only sandbox; commands are observed, never approved; edits and escalations are declined automatically.
config.codex.defaultProfile.1: Read-only sandbox; Codex must ask before each command; edits are declined automatically.
config.codex.defaultProfile.2: Read-only sandbox; Codex must ask before each command and before each patch. Approving a patch applies that entire patch.
config.codex.maxTurnMinutes: A Codex turn running longer than this is interrupted.
config.reviewer.enabled: Enable the optional Local AI Reviewer (Ollama). When disabled, Visual Agent makes no requests to Ollama at all. Agent tracking is unaffected either way.
config.reviewer.endpoint: Ollama HTTP endpoint. Only loopback addresses are accepted unless allowRemoteEndpoint is enabled.
config.reviewer.allowRemoteEndpoint: Allow a non-local Ollama endpoint. Code you review would be sent to that host.
config.reviewer.model: Preferred model (exact name from `ollama list`). Empty = qwen3:8b if installed, otherwise the first installed model. Models are never downloaded.
config.reviewer.thinking: Model reasoning ("thinking"). Off is fastest. gpt-oss models cannot disable reasoning; "off" maps to their lowest level.
config.reviewer.contextWindow: num_ctx sent to Ollama. Larger values use more GPU/system memory.
config.reviewer.maxContextChars: Maximum characters of code/context sent per request (lower-priority context is dropped first).
config.language: Language of the UI and the Local AI Reviewer: 中文, English or 中英双语 (bilingual). Does not affect the coding agent.
config.local.opencodePath: Path to the native OpenCode binary (opencode / opencode.exe). Empty = auto-detect (extension, global npm opencode-ai, PATH). Shell scripts are not accepted.
config.local.ollamaEndpoint: Ollama endpoint used by the local coding agent. Empty = the Local AI Reviewer endpoint. Only local inference is configured.
config.local.contextLimit: Context size (tokens) the local agent may use; capped by the model's own limit. Ollama allocates memory for the context it loads.
config.local.outputLimit: Maximum output tokens per local agent response.
cmd.explainCodeInDetail: Explain Selection / Function in Detail (Local AI)…
config.reviewer.explainMaxParts: Explain Code in Detail: maximum number of parts (one local request each) a large file or class is split into. Code beyond the limit is reported as not analyzed.
config.local.server.autoStart: When to start the local OpenCode server. It is always reused while healthy and only stopped if this window started it.
config.local.server.autoStart.onActivati: Also when the extension starts, with the last local-agent model and profile (no model request).
config.local.server.idleStopMinutes: Stop the OpenCode server this window started after this many minutes without a local-agent session. 0 = keep it running until VS Code closes.
